prompt: Among artists with multiple wins for Album of the Year at the Grammys, who has received the most nominations for this award, with each nomination occurring in a different year?
answer:
Taylor Swift and Paul Simon are tied, with **7 Album of the Year nominations each**, all occurring in different years.

Frank Sinatra had 8 nominations, but two occurred in 1959, so he had nominations in only 7 distinct years.
